title: Sent from Antioch to Cyprus
reflectionText: Barnabas and Saul were sent from a praying community into work that quickly met resistance. Paul answered Elymas directly, and the proconsul saw what happened and believed. Where can shared prayer, clear calling, and courage help a community remain faithful when someone tries to turn others away?
editorialNotes: Packet 021 initial writer output. Short-only plan. The retelling stays within Acts 13:1-12 and preserves the Antioch commissioning, the journey to Cyprus, Elymas’s opposition, Paul’s rebuke, and the proconsul’s belief.
